summary_en: Chiyoda Integre authorized acquisition of up to 100,000 shares (1.19% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of JPY 400 million through market purchases via ToSTNeT-3 and open market trading from November 13, 2026 to January 31, 2027, to enhance shareholder returns under the medium-term management plan and flexibly respond to changes in the business environment.
title_en: Notice regarding Determination of Matters concerning Treasury Stock Acquisition
translation_en_brief:
On November 12, 2026, Chiyoda Integre's board of directors authorized a treasury stock acquisition program under Article 156 of the Companies Act. The company will acquire up to 100,000 shares, representing 1.19% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock, for a maximum aggregate price of JPY 400 million. The per-share ceiling price is JPY 4,000. Purchases will be conducted through open market trading and ToSTNeT-3 transactions on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between November 13, 2026 and January 31, 2027.

The company stated two objectives for the buyback: to enhance shareholder returns as outlined in its medium-term management plan, and to maintain flexibility in capital policy in response to changes in the business environment. The authorization represents a measured capital return initiative within the framework of the company's strategic financial management.
